query:
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS sensor_readings (
    device_id   TEXT NOT NULL,
    observed_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL,
    value_mm    DOUBLE PRECISION NOT NULL,
    PRIMARY KEY (device_id, observed_at)
);

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS sensor_health (
    device_id   TEXT NOT NULL,
    observed_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL,
    batt_mv     INTEGER NOT NULL,
    rssi_dbm    DOUBLE PRECISION NOT NULL,
    PRIMARY KEY (device_id, observed_at)
);

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS errors (
    event_id     TEXT NOT NULL,
    time         TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL,
    dev_id       TEXT NOT NULL,
    deployment_id TEXT NOT NULL,
    level        TEXT NOT NULL,
    message      TEXT NOT NULL,
    type         TEXT NOT NULL,
    source       TEXT NOT NULL,
    data         JSONB NOT NULL,
    UNIQUE (event_id, time)
);

Log Error → Durable WritePlan
info:
Formats a caught Node-RED error as a versioned WritePlan and durably
enqueues it to the selected outbox sink. Run exactly one No-SQL Outbox worker
for that sink; logger instances enqueue only and do not create pollers.

For an existing table, apply:

ALTER TABLE errors ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS event_id TEXT;
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS errors_event_id_time_uidx
    ON errors (event_id, time);

The stable conflict key keeps retries after ambiguous PostgreSQL timeouts
idempotent.
